protocol.throughput_prompt: Explain how a CPU and GPU can cooperate to execute a mixture-of-experts model. Discuss memory bandwidth, expert placement, synchronization, and correctness in detail.

answer_check_prompts.arithmetic: Compute 17 times 19. Return only the integer.
answer_check_prompts.coding: Return only Python source code, without Markdown fences, implementing clamp(value, low, high). It must return min(high, max(low, value)). No imports, tests, comments, annotations, or explanation.

limitations: Sequential three-repeat technical screens with controls before and after hybrid, not randomized significance.
Only explicit hybrid mode is measured; no installed defaults or trained plan are modified.
GPT-OSS-20B uses an untrained causal cache, not GPT-OSS-120B's bound trained seed.
Causal residency starts empty on each load and persists across its three samples and subsequent answer checks.
No speculative decoding, weight changes or intentional removal of selected expert contributions.
Original throughput samples, numerical limits and failed answer checks are not replaced.
Generated-text hashes and two small answer checks are not independent native-reference numerical qualification.
GPU/RAM snapshots are not peak or minimum resource requirements.
Initial bracketing controls use the installed Standard binary; a separate final Standard control uses the hybrid executable and explicitly selected matching CUDA plugin.
